title: Window Graphics & Window Films in Bellinzona | VAM Deco
description: Window graphics and window films in Bellinzona: custom films and graphics on glass for shops, offices and studios across the city and Ticino. Free quote in 24/48h.
heroParagrafi: Make your business stand out wherever it is with our window graphics in Bellinzona: custom graphics on glass that get you noticed across the city, from the centre to the neighbourhoods and the surrounding municipalities.

Do you have a shop, a studio or an office in Bellinzona or elsewhere in Ticino? We create custom window films and decorative graphics that tell your brand's story to residents, commuters and passing customers, wherever your business is based.

We work only with high-quality materials and carefully crafted graphic designs, suited to boutiques in the centre just as much as to the offices and neighbourhood businesses across the cantonal capital and its surroundings.
claimArancione: We turn your windows into living signs that catch the eye all across Bellinzona and the rest of Ticino, wherever your business is located.
whatsappTesto: Hi VAM Deco, I'd like a quote for the window graphics for my business in Bellinzona.
beneficiTitolo: Why choose window graphics in Bellinzona?
beneficiIntro: In Bellinzona your window is your first calling card: it's seen by residents doing their shopping, commuters arriving at the station, people working in offices and the cantonal administration, and tourists heading to the three UNESCO World Heritage castles. Whether your business is in the centre, in a neighbourhood or in a nearby municipality, a window dressed with window graphics, stickers and decorative films helps you get recognised and stop passers-by, all across the city and the rest of Ticino.

benefici.testo: Where people walk slowly, among pedestrian streets and arcades, a well-designed window graphic stops passers-by in their tracks and invites them into your business, in any part of Bellinzona.
On the busiest days, such as market Saturdays, a decorated window helps you stand out from the crowd and turns the foot traffic into new sales opportunities.
We design every graphic around your sector, from a boutique to a professional practice: colours, logo and messaging always consistent with your identity, wherever you are.
Window films withstand years of sun and weather, from the sultry days of summer to Ticino's autumn rains: a one-off cost, with no recurring fees like advertising placements.
With frosted films and etched-glass effects you give privacy to offices, professional practices and institutional premises, without giving up natural light or a touch of elegance.

benefici.titolo: Sets you apart from your neighbours
benefici.testo: In a canton rich in neighbourhood businesses and craftsmanship, a well-kept window makes you stand out from the shops next door and conveys care and professionalism at a glance.

fasi.d: During this first phase we immerse ourselves in your needs and goals. We analyse the type of project and work closely with you to understand exactly what you want to achieve from your window in Bellinzona.

We develop a free, tailored quote, choosing the technologies and materials that best suit the job, to ensure every detail lives up to expectations. We create designs that reflect your brand, capture attention and enhance your image.

Once the project is approved, we move to the operational phase: with our cutting-edge equipment we handle production and installation at your premises or ours, depending on your needs. Everything is carried out with precision and on schedule.

Once the project is complete, we carry out a detailed inspection to make sure everything meets the required quality standards. We remain available to provide ongoing support and ensure you are completely satisfied.

faq.domanda: How much does it cost to decorate a window in Bellinzona?
faq.risposta: The cost depends on the size of the window, the type of design and the materials chosen. We prepare a tailored, free quote in 24/48h, so you receive a clear proposal made to measure for your business, with no obligation.

faq.domanda: Which areas of Bellinzona and its surroundings do you cover?
faq.risposta: We cover all of Bellinzona, from the old town and Viale Stazione to the neighbourhoods and local businesses, as well as nearby municipalities such as Giubiasco, Arbedo and Sementina, where our business is based. We come to your window, wherever it is.

faq.domanda: Can you install without closing the shop or work outside opening hours?
faq.risposta: Yes. We arrange the installation around your hours, even before opening or at the end of the day, so you don't interrupt your business even on the busiest days such as Saturday.

faq.domanda: How long does it take to install on a window?
faq.risposta: Application usually takes four or five hours, but the time can vary depending on the complexity of the design and the size of the surface to be covered.

faq.domanda: Are the films also suitable for privacy in offices and studios?
faq.risposta: Absolutely. Frosted films and etched-glass effects are ideal for offices, professional practices and institutional premises across Bellinzona: they ensure privacy while letting natural light through.

faq.domanda: Can I decorate just part of the window, such as the logo or lettering?
faq.risposta: Yes, we can decorate specific portions of the glass, such as a logo, opening hours or a slogan, for a targeted impact without having to cover the entire surface.

faq.domanda: Do the materials withstand the weather?
faq.risposta: Yes. We use high-quality materials that are resistant to UV rays and the elements, designed to keep their colours and appearance over time both under the summer sun and in the rain.

faq.domanda: Does the window need to be prepared before application?
faq.risposta: The window must be clean and free of dust or residue to ensure a perfect bond. We take care of cleaning the surface ourselves at the time of installation, so the result is flawless.
